list: the official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18 (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is not a task of its own: it lands the moment the other 54 trophies are on your profile. Guides put the list at roughly 200 hours with no difficulty setting, no online requirement and one playthrough, since free roam continues after the credits. Watch the remaining count at the top of this tracker rather than chasing the platinum directly.
steps: Leave the platinum to last: it lands the moment the other 54 trophies are on your profile (KeenGamer).
Budget roughly 200 hours for one playthrough, with no difficulty setting and no online requirement (PowerPyx).
Work the silver and gold rows first — 100% completion, 250 stunts and the shooting-range golds decide the length (PowerPyx).
Watch the count at the top of this tracker rather than chasing the platinum directly (Exophase).
trophies.tips: Check the silver and gold rows first: 100% completion, 250 stunts and the shooting-range golds are what actually decide how long the platinum takes.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Pops at the end of Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1, so a fresh save earns it inside the first hour. Nothing in the mission can be failed in a way that costs the trophy. PowerPyx files it as an automatic story trophy with no other condition.
steps: Play Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1 (Exophase).
Finish it: the trophy is automatic and nothing in the mission can be failed in a way that costs it (PowerPyx).
Nothing else is required of the mission, so a fresh save earns it inside the first hour (Exophase).

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 1; both PowerPyx and GTABase place the pop at the start of Chapter 2, when What's in the Bag? opens, not on the last mission of Chapter 1 itself. Nothing in the chapter can lock it out. The one thing to do first is Lucia's balcony meditation, which is only offered before this point.
steps: Finish Chapter 1; the pop lands at the start of Chapter 2, when What's in the Bag? opens (PowerPyx).
Before the chapter ends, take Lucia's balcony meditation — it is offered only up to that point (GTABase).
Make a manual save at the end of Chapter 1, the last moment the meditation can be taken (PowerPyx).
Nothing else in the chapter can lock the trophy out (Exophase).
trophies.tips: Make a manual save at the end of Chapter 1: this is the last moment the balcony meditation can be taken.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. GTABase puts the unlock at the start of Chapter 3, after Welcome to Vice City. Chapter 2 is also where partner free roam (Coffee Break), the Scooter Bros app and the garage property market open, so several other trophies become possible as this one lands.
steps: Play through Chapter 2 (Exophase).
Expect the pop at the start of Chapter 3, after Welcome to Vice City (GTABase).
Use the same chapter for its unlocks: partner free roam (Coffee Break), the Scooter Bros app and the garage property market (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. PowerPyx and GTABase both place the pop after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is where the Snap Gun and jewelry jobs (Yasmani), the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering and the Key Cloner strand begin.
steps: Play through Chapter 3 (Exophase).
The pop lands after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life (PowerPyx).
While the chapter runs, pick up the Snap Gun and Yasmani's jewelry jobs, the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering, and the start of the Key Cloner strand (GTABase).

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. PowerPyx ties the pop to the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero. It cannot be missed and needs no performance in the mission. Save before that last stretch if you still want to leave optional content for later.
steps: Play Chapter 4 to its final mission, Starting From Zero (PowerPyx).
Finish the mission: nothing in it can be missed and no performance is needed (Exophase).
Save before the last stretch if you want to leave optional content for later (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission; it is the second of the list's two golds. GTABase notes free roam carries on after the credits, so every 100% task can be cleaned up afterwards. There is no mission replay and no trophy depends on how a mission is played.
steps: Finish the final story mission — the second of the list's two golds (Exophase).
Carry on after the credits: free roam stays open, so every 100% task can be cleaned up afterwards (GTABase).
Nothing more is needed — there is no mission replay and no trophy depends on how a mission is played (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Trust unlocks during Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 main mission that PowerPyx titles as checking on Jason. It is automatic once the mission ends, with no optional objective attached. Nothing in the mission can be failed in a way that costs the trophy, so any story run collects it.
steps: Play Breakfast Run, the Chapter 2 main mission PowerPyx titles as checking on Jason (PowerPyx).
Finish the mission for the automatic pop (Exophase).
No optional objective is attached, so the trophy costs nothing but the mission itself (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Break the Bank unlocks during The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 main mission. The pop is automatic: no optional objective and no performance requirement. It sits in the same chapter as the jewelry and laundering unlocks, so a story run picks it up without a detour.
steps: Play The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 main mission (PowerPyx).
Finish it — the trophy is automatic (Exophase).
Take the jewelling and laundering unlocks in the same chapter rather than making a detour (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Family Matters unlocks during Child's Play, the Chapter 4 main mission in which Rafa is rescued from kidnappers. The trophy is automatic once the mission ends. If you die, the mission restarts from a checkpoint, so the mission itself is the only fail state and it costs nothing permanent.
steps: Play Child's Play, the Chapter 4 mission in which Rafa is rescued from kidnappers (PowerPyx).
Finish the mission; the trophy needs nothing else (Exophase).
If you die, a checkpoint restart is enough: the mission is the only fail state (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: DWNFALL unlocks during Headliners, a Chapter 4 main mission built around a launch party. It is automatic and needs no optional objective. It arrives in the same chapter as the other three Chapter 4 story trophies, so one story stretch clears all four.
steps: Play Headliners, the Chapter 4 mission built around a launch party (PowerPyx).
Finish it for the automatic pop (Exophase).
Pair it with the other three Chapter 4 story trophies in one stretch (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unlocks during VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 main mission. Automatic. It has nothing to do with the airport plane trophy Catch Me If You Can beyond sharing the airport as a location.
steps: Play VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 main mission (PowerPyx).
Finish it — the trophy arrives automatically (Exophase).
Do not confuse it with Catch Me If You Can: only the airport is shared between them (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Snow Storm unlocks during Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 main mission. The pop is automatic, so finishing the mission is all it asks. It is one of the last story trophies before the final-mission gold, which makes it the marker for the end of the roadmap's story stretch.
steps: Play Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 main mission (PowerPyx).
Finish it for the automatic pop (Exophase).
Treat it as the end of the story stretch — the final-mission gold follows it (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game list under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, which appears once the story is done. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the list can be missed. It is not true 100%: required in full are all robberies (8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations), the underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting-range golds, all 42 drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks, while the rest are partial. The in-game list is the authority for the last few percent, not this tracker.
steps: Finish the story first — the 100% list only opens once the credits roll (PowerPyx).

Clear the categories required in full — all robberies (8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations), the underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting-range golds, all 42 drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks (GTABase).
Top up the partial ones: 300 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal scans, 100 of 255 WAiNK scans, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 100 optional missions (Pro-Gamer).
Check the in-game list for the last few percent — it is the authority, not this tracker (Duuro Plays).
trophies.tips: Do the required-in-full categories first; they are also the ones that carry their own trophies. Use the in-game checklist, not this tracker, as the authority for the last few percent.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge fly-unders, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges in a helicopter or plane is the fastest way to add numbers, and the optional challenge attached to each stunt is not needed. The 100% checklist wants 300, so this trophy arrives on the way to A Long Road.
steps: Fly under bridges with a helicopter or plane: 202 of the 397 stunts are under-the-bridge fly-unders and they add numbers fastest (PowerPyx).
Fill in with the 130 stunt jumps, the 40 knife flights and the 25 base jumps as you travel between other objectives (GTABase).
Track the count under Progress > Activities > Stunts and turn stunt spots on in the map filter (PowerPyx).
Stop at 250 for the trophy; the 100% checklist wants 300, so the trophy arrives on the way (Pro-Gamer).
trophies.tips: Track the count under Progress > Activities > Stunts and turn the stunt spots on in the map filter.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, an arcade game, winning a race and a stunt. Progress > Activities lists each type with its count, and the map's Activities filter shows what is nearby. Most types are introduced by the story, so this usually fills itself.
steps: Try all nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, an arcade game, winning a race and a stunt (PowerPyx).
Check Progress > Activities, which lists each type with its count (GTABase).
Use the map's Activities filter to see what is nearby (PowerPyx).
Most types are introduced by the story, so this usually fills itself as you play (GTABase).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds spread over 12 ranges. Golds reward accuracy and speed, so learn a range's target order on a first run and retry for time. Range practice also raises Focus, which helps with Gunslinger.
steps: Pick a shooting range off the map and learn each challenge's target order on a slow, accurate run (PowerPyx).
Retry for the clock from the range's own score screen — leaving the building costs a reload (GTABase).
Clear all 42 golds across the 12 ranges, finishing a range completely before moving on (Pro-Gamer).
Range practice also raises Focus, which is what Gunslinger needs (PowerPyx).
trophies.tips: Nine of the 42 are usually the last: keep the range's own score screen open and restart instead of leaving the building.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so clear every race at a location in one visit. Locations appear as the map unfogs.
steps: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations (PowerPyx).
One win per location is enough for the trophy (GTABase).
Clear every race at a location in one visit: the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races (PowerPyx).
Watch the map unfog to find the locations as they appear (GTABase).

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on the map. Winning the same race twice does not count towards the twenty, so spread the wins. Combine it with Top Fun by taking a drone race at each of the 14 locations. Pick short routes over long ones: the count, not the prize, is what the trophy wants.
steps: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on the map (PowerPyx).
Spread the wins: winning the same race twice does not count towards the twenty (GTABase).
Take a drone race at each of the 14 locations so the wins also feed Top Fun (PowerPyx).
Pick short routes over long ones — the count is what the trophy wants, not the prize (GTABase).

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After meeting Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts a purple fishing marker; play his fishing strand and beat him in the challenge. Fishing is a timing minigame, so wait for the bite before reeling. GTABase notes the strand stays open after the story, so a lost challenge costs nothing.
steps: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui; he then texts a purple fishing marker (PowerPyx).
Play his fishing strand and beat him in the challenge (GTABase).
Wait for the bite before reeling: fishing is a timing minigame (PowerPyx).
Losing costs nothing — the strand stays open after the story (GTABase).

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade cabinets: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are on the TV at Jason and Lucia's home and playable from Chapter 1; the fourth is on cabinets out in Leonida. Finishing means reaching the end of the game, not setting a score.
steps: Pick one of the four cabinets: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck (PowerPyx).
Use the TV at Jason and Lucia's home: the first three are playable from Chapter 1, while the fourth sits on cabinets out in Leonida (GTABase).
Reach the end of the game rather than a score (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's five jobs are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when she gets his call and the Belville address. The order is Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass, and the last one awards the trophy. All five stay on the map in free roam, so the strand cannot be closed off.
steps: Start Andy's strand in Chapter 3, when Lucia gets his call and the Belville address (PowerPyx).
Take the five Lucia-only jobs in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass (GTABase).
Finish Puff Puff Pass for the trophy (PowerPyx).
Leave any of them for later if you like: all five stay on the map in free roam (GTABase).

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton, the green KR marker in Key Lento, hires Jason in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from seven shipwrecks: dive at the purple chest markers and dig with the metal detector. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and texts again later, so the strand is finished after the story. Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures tracks the seven.
steps: Find Kenton's green KR marker in Key Lento, where he hires Jason in Chapter 1 (PowerPyx).
Dive at the purple chest markers and dig with the metal detector to recover treasure from seven shipwrecks (GTABase).
Expect him to go quiet after Chapter 1 and text again later, so the strand is finished after the story (PowerPyx).
Track the seven under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures (GTABase).

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs are marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County once Coffee Break in Chapter 2 is done. The fifth job, Hometown Heroes, is the one that awards the trophy. The strand stays available after the credits, so a story run can leave the whole line until clean-up.
steps: Finish Coffee Break in Chapter 2, which marks Billy's jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County (PowerPyx).
Play his five jobs; Hometown Heroes, the fifth, awards the trophy (GTABase).
Take the line whenever it suits — the strand stays available after the credits (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger strands anywhere in Leonida. GTABase counts Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete as qualifying and the Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie lines as not counting, so pick strangers rather than contacts. The trophy's own counter in the trophy list is the reliable check on progress. None of it is needed for 100%, and the strands stay open after the story.
steps: Finish eight qualifying stranger strands anywhere in Leonida (Exophase).
Pick strangers rather than contacts: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete qualify, while the Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie lines do not count (GTABase).
Trust the trophy's own counter in the trophy list for progress (PowerPyx).
Skip the grind if you want — none of it is needed for 100% and the strands stay open after the story (GTABase).

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which also gives you the Key Cloner. Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City, and scan cars with WAiNK to see whether they are on it; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best hunting grounds. Better condition pays more but is not required.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS for Randy's Wish List and the Key Cloner (PowerPyx).
Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (GTABase).
Scan cars with WAiNK to see which are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach hunt best (PowerPyx).
Condition pays more but is not required (GTABase).

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: A Jason-only strand: after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone marks synthetic labs around Vice City in purple. Destroy the labs, and his last job, Shut Down the Labs, awards the trophy. It stays available after the story.
steps: Finish Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3 (Jason only) to start Tyrone's strand (PowerPyx).
Destroy the synthetic labs he marks in purple around Vice City (GTABase).
Finish his last job, Shut Down the Labs, for the trophy; the strand stays available after the story (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.lostAt: Lost in stage 1 — the balcony meditation is offered only before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida; meditating at a spot with both characters together counts twice, and the last spot needs both, which becomes possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The one that can be lost: the morning after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony at home and accept her meditation, because the scene disappears once Chapter 1 ends and guides still disagree on whether the trophy counts it. Track the total under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
steps: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida (PowerPyx).
Meditate with both characters together wherever the map allows: a spot done by both counts twice (GTABase).
Before Chapter 1 ends, take the balcony meditation: the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen and accept her offer (KeenGamer).
Save the last spot for after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, the point where both characters can travel together (PowerPyx).
trophies.tips: A manual save before the last Chapter 1 mission turns a lost balcony meditation into a five-minute rewind instead of a second 200-hour run.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel texts Jason after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break (Lucia cannot receive it) and starts Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Hunt the animals on his purple Target Decks with a rifle; a clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy is not settled, and all 15 Target Decks are needed for 100% anyway.
steps: Finish Coffee Break in Chapter 2 to get Bret Vogel's text — Jason only, since Lucia cannot receive it (PowerPyx).
Play Veteran Hunted in Lummox County (GTABase).
Hunt the animals on his purple Target Decks with a rifle; a clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required (PowerPyx).
Clear all 15 decks anyway: they are needed for 100%, and no guide settles which animal triggers the trophy (GTABase).

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any three Collectible Card sets; you do not need all of them. Progress > Collections shows each set's count and the cards still missing. The cards sit in fixed spots, so a set becomes a short tour once the remainder is known, and no card can be missed.
steps: Pick any three Collectible Card sets — not all of them (Exophase).
Use Progress > Collections to see each set's count and the cards still missing (GTABase).
Tour the fixed card spots for a set once the remainder is known (Exophase).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the phone app: hold Up on the D-pad, then R1/RB. The pool is 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags, so any hundred count. A hundred WAiNK scans are also part of the 100% checklist, so the trophy comes first.
steps: Hold Up on the D-pad, then R1/RB, to open the WAiNK app (PowerPyx).
Scan 100 spots: the pool is 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags, so any hundred count (GTABase).
Keep scanning past the trophy if 100% matters — a hundred WAiNK scans are also on the checklist (PowerPyx).
trophies.tips: Scanning from a car covers ground quickly, and the app marks what is already scanned.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges; Progress > Challenges ticks the finished ones. Many complete themselves as you play, and the 100% checklist wants 70, so this arrives on the way. Ten challenges are spare, which means the slowest ones can be left alone.
steps: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges (PowerPyx).
Check Progress > Challenges for the ones already ticked (GTABase).
Play on and many complete themselves; the 100% checklist wants 70, so this arrives on the way (PowerPyx).
Leave the ten spare, slowest challenges alone (GTABase).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Once both characters can be out together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner with Right on the D-pad then Triangle/Y, build a four-star wanted level and escape. It only counts after you are out of the red heat zone, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a known place to lose helicopters. Bank vault robberies always give four stars, so the trophy often pops there by accident.
steps: Wait for Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when both characters can be out together (PowerPyx).
Call your partner with Right on the D-pad then Triangle/Y (GTABase).
Build a four-star wanted level and escape; it only counts once you are out of the red heat zone (PowerPyx).
Lose the helicopters in the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, or take a bank vault, which always gives four stars (GTABase).

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner along, rob three shops back-to-back while the police are still chasing you; losing the wanted level breaks the chain. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3, are close enough to chain, and body armour and healing items make the run survivable. The trophy can lag about thirty seconds after the third shop, so rob a fourth before deciding it failed.
steps: Bring your partner and rob three shops back-to-back while the police are still chasing you (PowerPyx).
Do not lose the wanted level between shops: that breaks the chain (GTABase).
Use the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 — they are close enough to chain (PowerPyx).
Carry body armour and healing items, then rob a fourth shop: the trophy can lag about thirty seconds after the third (GTABase).

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK; you never have to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic, or sweep a car park. The 100% checklist wants 200 base models, so this comes well before A Long Road.
steps: Scan vehicles with WAiNK; you never have to drive them (PowerPyx).
Discover 100 different vehicles — stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic, or sweep a car park (GTABase).
Push on to 200 base models, which is what the 100% checklist wants, well before A Long Road (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies inside one Combat Focus, triggered by clicking both sticks while aiming a firearm. Fill the Focus meter first, since eating, drinking and washing up at home raise it and Adrenaline extends the window, then use an accurate automatic rifle such as the Duke 556. Gang-operation thugs count; police, soldiers and civilians appear not to.
steps: Fill the Focus meter first: eating, drinking and washing up at home raise it, and Adrenaline extends the window (PowerPyx).
Click both sticks while aiming a firearm to trigger Combat Focus (GTABase).
Take down five enemies inside that single Focus with an accurate automatic rifle such as the Duke 556 (PowerPyx).
Aim at gang-operation thugs: police, soldiers and civilians appear not to count (GTABase).

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger jet docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA (planes parked out on the airfield do not count), back it out, take off and fly about a kilometre clear of the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easy ones: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs. It is a hidden trophy, so expect no hint in the list until it pops.
steps: Reach the boarding bridges at VCIA; gates E3 and E4 are the easy ones — drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs (PowerPyx).
Steal a large passenger jet docked at a boarding bridge; planes parked out on the airfield do not count (GTABase).
Back it out, take off and fly about a kilometre clear of the airport (PowerPyx).
Expect no hint in the list: it is a hidden trophy until it pops (GTABase).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, where the tanks stand at the south end of the base. Drive in through the gate, or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance. Once inside, take enemies out from the tank's own weapons rather than on foot. The trophy pops on the kills, so there is no need to escape with the tank.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County (PowerPyx).
Get in through the gate, or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance (GTABase).
Find the tanks at the south end of the base and steal one (PowerPyx).
Take enemies out from inside the tank until the trophy unlocks (GTABase).

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 unlock jewelry-store robberies and the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors. Use the Snap Gun on the back door rather than kicking it in, find the safe-code note in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted, since setting off the alarm voids the attempt. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the store most guides use.
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 for jewelry-store robberies and the Snap Gun (PowerPyx).
Pick the back door and use the Snap Gun rather than kicking it in — the alarm voids the attempt (GTABase).
Find the safe-code note in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted (PowerPyx).
Use Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City, the store most guides pick (GTABase).

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults open with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is...: tail a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it stands open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner, and since vaults always give four stars, escape on a fast bike and switch vehicles. Five of the eight vaults are enough for the trophy and all eight are needed for 100%.
steps: Open the vaults with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is...: tail a security van to its bank and get in while the vault stands open (PowerPyx).
Hand a bag to your partner — the haul is too heavy for one character (GTABase).
Escape on a fast bike and switch vehicles: vaults always give four stars (Pro-Gamer).
Stop at five of the eight vaults for the trophy; all eight are needed for 100% (PowerPyx).
trophies.tips: Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 if a particular vault is hard to find.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck as long as you then escape the heat or reach a Pay 'n' Spray, so this often arrives together with Maximum Withdrawal. Earlier in the game, box in a moving armored truck, sticky-bomb its back doors, blow them and get away. The escape is the part that counts: an abandoned attempt banks nothing.
steps: Box in a moving armored truck, sticky-bomb its back doors, blow them and get away (PowerPyx).
Escape the heat or reach a Pay 'n' Spray to bank it (GTABase).
Alternatively rob a bank vault: it counts as an armored truck, so the trophy often arrives with Maximum Withdrawal (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. Flying a plane over every dark patch is the quickest method and you never need to land. The trophy tracks map discovery, not collectibles, so a handful of long flights finishes it. Leave the far islands for a flight of their own, since the water crossing is the slow part.
steps: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida (PowerPyx).
Fly a plane over every dark patch — the quickest method, and you never need to land (GTABase).
Ignore collectibles: the trophy tracks map discovery, so a handful of long flights finishes it (PowerPyx).
Take the far islands in a flight of their own, since the water crossing is the slow part (GTABase).

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs; they are the yellow map icons, many of them marked by story progress. Progress > Gangs keeps the count, and repeating a gang does not help. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this one comes on the way.
steps: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs (PowerPyx).
Look for the yellow map icons, many of them marked by story progress (GTABase).
Check Progress > Gangs for the count; repeating one gang does not help (PowerPyx).
Plan for all 39 operations anyway: the 100% checklist wants every one (GTABase).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail somewhere with a view over Ocean Beach in Vice City. PowerPyx names the Ocean View rooftop bar and an Apple Martini, drunk while standing next to the bar. It is a hidden trophy, so nothing in the list hints at the bar until it pops.
steps: Go to the Ocean View rooftop bar over Ocean Beach in Vice City (PowerPyx).
Order an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar (Pro-Gamer).
Expect nothing in the list until it pops: it is a hidden trophy (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it out through the showroom window. PowerPyx notes the car can only be taken once you have the Key Cloner from Randy's Chapter 3 strand, so finish that first. Hidden trophy, no in-game hint.
steps: Take the Key Cloner from Randy's Chapter 3 strand first — the car cannot be taken without it (PowerPyx).
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City (Pro-Gamer).
Steal the blue Banshee and drive it out through the showroom window (PowerPyx).
Expect no in-game hint: it is a hidden trophy (Pro-Gamer).

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take all three valuables — the watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table and the safe in the north-east hallway, which needs sticky bombs — then lose the police. The robbery takes a long time to come back, so take everything in one visit.
steps: Start it as a gang operation marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2, at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (PowerPyx).
Take the watch in the south-east office (GTABase).
Take the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which needs sticky bombs (Pro-Gamer).
Lose the police, and take everything in one visit: the robbery takes a long time to come back (GTABase).

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength on both Jason and Lucia, visible under Jason & Lucia > Strength in the pause menu. Work out at fitness clubs from the map's Activities filter with your partner along, because training one trains the other. After the story you can also train at home, which saves the drive between visits to a club.
steps: Bring your partner to a fitness club from the map's Activities filter — training one trains the other (PowerPyx).
Max out Strength on both Jason and Lucia; check it under Jason & Lucia > Strength in the pause menu (GTABase).
Train at home too once the story is done, which saves the drive between visits (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that shift your Criminal Profile; the trophy itself shows the count out of 500 when you open it. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings > UI so each shift is visible, and otherwise play normally, since robberies and fights add up quickly. Do not push the meter all the way to Irredeemable, which is permanent.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings > UI so each shift is visible (PowerPyx).
Perform 500 actions that shift your Criminal Profile; the trophy itself shows the count out of 500 (GTABase).
Play normally — robberies and fights add up quickly (PowerPyx).
Do not push the meter all the way to Irredeemable, which is permanent (GTABase).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description, Second time's the charm, points to succeeding at something on a second attempt. PowerPyx links it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, but no guide has confirmed the trigger. Treat it as a clean-up trophy: play a full run and check the tracker afterwards before hunting it. It is the one row worth leaving open to the end, since nothing else on this list can be lost.
steps: Read the description, Second time's the charm, as a hint at succeeding on a second attempt (PowerPyx).
Try the Payday Loans store from the prologue, which PowerPyx links to the trigger (PowerPyx).
Treat it as clean-up: play a full run, then check the tracker before hunting it — no guide has confirmed the trigger (GTABase).

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: This is the UFO Easter egg: on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, after 2 AM and alone. A blinking car at the roadside means the event can fire; if it is not there, drive away and come back, because the spawn is not guaranteed. Follow the prompt that appears beside the car.
steps: Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, after 2 AM and alone (PowerPyx).
Look for a blinking car at the roadside — that means the event can fire (Pro-Gamer).
Drive away and come back if the car is missing: the spawn is not guaranteed (PowerPyx).
Follow the prompt that appears beside the car (Pro-Gamer).

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description asks for a melee drive-by: knock somebody down from a moving vehicle with a melee attack. PowerPyx suspects kicking enemies from a motorcycle, and no guide has confirmed the trigger yet. Try it against gang members rather than pedestrians and check the trophy list after each attempt.
steps: Knock somebody down from a moving vehicle with a melee attack (PowerPyx).
Try kicking enemies from a motorcycle, the trigger PowerPyx suspects (GTABase).
Aim at gang members rather than pedestrians, and check the trophy list after each attempt — nobody has confirmed the trigger yet (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to get the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and sell the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is a running total across robberies, not one delivery. Bank vaults hand over up to $205,000 a time but only open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is...
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) for the Dye Pack Jammer (PowerPyx).
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most (GTABase).
Treat $250,000 as a running total across robberies, not one delivery (KeenGamer).
Use bank vaults for the big deposits — up to $205,000 a time, but only after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is... (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a running total of $100,000 across shops of any kind. Guns, car mods and tattoos use money fastest, with 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays and the clothing and electronics stores on the map. Robberies fund it, so do it after a few scores rather than grinding a job.
steps: Spend a running total of $100,000 across shops of any kind (PowerPyx).
Spend where money goes fastest: guns, car mods and tattoos (GTABase).
Shop from the map's 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays and the clothing and electronics stores (PowerPyx).
Fund it from a few robberies rather than grinding a job (GTABase).

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garages for sale through the Vice City Real Estate app, which installs after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver; the four garages the story hands you do not count. The eight cost about $160,000 together. Robberies are the quickest way to raise it, and the garages also give On the Spot its parking space.
steps: Wait for the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, which installs the Vice City Real Estate app (PowerPyx).
Buy all eight garages for sale in the app; the four the story hands you do not count (GTABase).
Budget about $160,000 for the eight (PowerPyx).
Raise it with robberies — the garages also give On the Spot its parking space (GTABase).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app arrives with Moses' Chapter 2 mission, and stolen vehicles are registered at his Port Gellhorn garage after a respray. At first he takes only cars without trackers; from Chapter 3 any Pay 'n' Spray can register tracked ones. Each registration costs money and needs free garage space, so use cheap cars and bikes.
steps: Get the Scooter Bros app with Moses' Chapter 2 mission (PowerPyx).
Take stolen vehicles for a respray at his Port Gellhorn garage to register them (GTABase).
Start with cars without trackers, which is all he takes at first; from Chapter 3 any Pay 'n' Spray can register tracked ones (PowerPyx).
Register 10 vehicles in total; each costs money and needs free garage space, so use cheap cars and bikes (GTABase).

notes: Hidden flags follow the 28 trophies PSN hides until earned (PlanetGTA6). Guides are written for this entry; each step and each source is named beside the fact it supports.
